CONCLUSION AND RECOMMENDATIONS Shale hydration is very common in Miocene and Oligocene sections in this area. Sloughing shales, tight spots, obstructions and fill are also very common in the Eocene - Paleocene sections. Several cases of high drag and sticking have been reported.
